description: Check that affiliate tracking works, after the tracking script has been added: fetches a page of the site (the business website unless url is given) and looks for this account's tag, then says whether a browser has run the script, whether a payment platform is connected, and whether a test-mode purchase has reached LinkJolt (the one tool that shows test sales). Each check comes with a sentence and next names the first thing left to do. Run it after the script is deployed, and again after the person buys once in their payment platform's test mode through an affiliate link. Requires Pro plan or higher, or a new account that has not picked a plan yet.

url.description: The page to check, e.g. https://acme.com/pricing (default: the business website)

name: check_tracking
title: Check tracking works
